run_retinanet_domain_eval: run retinanet evaluation with domain-specific BatchNorm using a checkpoint path argument
run_precise_bn_update: run precise BatchNorm statistics update on the retinanet model using 500 training samples
run_inference_on_dataset: run inference on a test dataset using the retinanet model and evaluator
review_CycleBatchNormList: review the CycleBatchNormList layer used to replace BatchNorm in the retinanet head
review_DetectionCheckpointer: review the DetectionCheckpointer used to load model weights from a checkpoint file
